cover: Use case: illustration-story. Create an eye-catching minimalist flat-vector editorial cover, wide 2.4:1 landscape. Clean charcoal background with warm-white title and coral-orange graphic accents. Exact headline across upper-left in large readable contemporary sans-serif: 'Resuming an eval without changing the experiment'. Small uppercase label 'AI EVALS'. Across lower-right a single simple filmstrip is interrupted by a narrow clean cut, and one small orange splice joins its two matching halves. Both halves have the same outline, width and sprocket pattern, with sparse identical abstract frame shapes, making it clear this is the same reel continuing. No filmmaking scenery or equipment. One deliberate graphic metaphor for checkpoint continuation, elegant negative space, crisp geometric shapes, no photorealism, no grain, no vintage distress or engraving. Do not put timecodes, numbers, wording or fake experimental results on the filmstrip. Keep illustration to one strip and one splice, not a complex timeline diagram. No robot, brain, circuit board, check mark, watermark or logo. Full title legible at thumbnail size, generous safe margins.
